relations: Upright mosaic blocks stand vertically on the floor, with the wavy bottom and left edge lines remaining intact.
If lower-left corner blocks tip over, they lie flat showing broad colored faces, widening into a diagonal collapse front.
The collapse front sweeps across the lower-left quadrant, leaving central, upper, and right areas erect.
Dark bottom-right edge blocks also begin to lie down while the main front stays in the lower left.
caption: The video showcases a large square mosaic portrait of a stylized face, built from thousands of upright, multicolored domino-like blocks on a light wooden floor. A wavy line of blocks traces the bottom edge and climbs the left edge, meeting the mosaic at its lower-left corner. The field stands erect, then a small cluster at the bottom-left corner tips over, lying flat and showing broad, colored faces of fallen blocks. This fallen zone widens as a diagonal collapse front, sweeping from the corner across the lower-left quadrant and climbing toward the center. The boundary between upright and flattened blocks advances steadily, eroding the left and lower portions while the central, upper, and right areas remain erect. Near the end, dark bottom-right edge blocks also begin to lie down, while the main front stays in the lower left. The camera stays fixed and the bottom and left edge lines remain unchanged, leaving the cascade in progress as the clip ends.
